reason: Converts Zod input schemas to JSON Schema for the OpenAPI generator, so request and response bodies are documented from the same Zod types the router validates against.
maintenance: Part of the @orpc/* v2 beta family already adopted; tracks the same beta.28 release.
provenance: Official @orpc/zod package, resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: No smaller existing dependency provides Zod-to-JSON-Schema conversion compatible with @orpc/openapi's converter interface.
